_README: Copy this to tools/profile.json and edit. That path is gitignored - it is your private data, never commit it. Run 'python tools/find_awards.py --facets' to see every valid value for the enumerated fields.
_note_citizenship_gpa: These two are NOT used as filters - the source directory does not record them per award. They are here for your own reference; the tool instead flags awards whose eligibility text mentions citizenship (!cit) or a grade cutoff (!gpa) so you can check those by hand.
_note_affiliations: Only set these if they apply to you. Awards restricted to an affiliation are excluded unless it matches, so a wrong value here hides awards.
